derivation: Renewal eligibility holds and current authority succeeds, so evaluation reaches the single reservation transition. RES-006 tests the same contribution against the current committed window plus all still-unsettled exposure and the bound is violated, so the registry returns WITHHELD with reason BOUND_VIOLATED. LIFE-007 commits the registry withholding receipt and next revision together with one WITHHELD proposal record carrying the successful authority-result digest, the one receipt digest, a null permit digest and the exact prior-permit digest. Its lifecycle reason codes are the sorted union of the receipt reasons and BUDGET_WITHHELD. No new or extended reservation is created and the prior permit is not superseded.
